title: Fees Recovered with a ShieldCare Premium Settlement
content:
Which fees standing on a Northbeam ShieldCare Protection Plan are taken with a premium settlement
is read from the plan's own premium history: whether a fee stands billed on the plan inside the last
12 months, and how many premium payments stand on it in that time.

| What the plan's history shows | The fees taken with the settlement |
| --- | --- |
| a fee stands billed on the plan inside the last 12 months, and at least 6 premium payments stand on it in that time | the fees billed on the plan inside the last 12 months are taken |
| at least 6 premium payments stand on the plan in the last 12 months, and no fee stands billed on the plan in that time | the most recent fee standing on the plan is taken, whenever it was billed |
| every other plan | no fee standing on the plan is taken with the settlement |

### Both sides of the payment count

Exactly 6 premium payments in the last 12 months satisfies the count; 5 payments does not, and a
plan with 5 payments takes no fee with the settlement however many fees stand on it. The two upper
rows are separated by the fee history alone: with a fee inside the year, the year's fees are taken
together; with no fee inside the year but one standing further back, that one fee is taken.

### A case on hypothetical figures

A plan showing 4 premium payments in the last 12 months takes no fee with the settlement at all, however many
fees stand on it. A plan showing 9 payments in that year, with its only fee billed 18 months ago at 9.00, takes
that 9.00. A plan showing 9 payments in that year and two fees inside it, of 9.00 and 15.00, takes the fees of
that year, 24.00 together.
